Feedback Text: I really love Blinkit's speed, but I only use the app to buy milk and eggs. I don't feel motivated to try wellness products because they are expensive.
I tried buying fresh paneer last week, but the app sent me one that was close to expiry. The trust isn't there, so I avoid other fresh categories now.
The search function is annoying. If I search for organic tea, it displays standard tea. Very frustrating to discover premium items.
I always check out in 15 seconds. It is a convenience tool. I don't use it for browsing new items, I use Zepto or physical stores for exploring snacks.
